title: Build for compatibility with older glibc
description: Use zigbuild (as Ark and Kallichore do) so that PET works on older versions of Linux.

title: build and upload binary
description:
Goal of this repository is to grab the source code of the latest [python environment tools](https://github.com/microsoft/python-environment-tools), build it, and post the binary in a release.

Then, on the Positron side, we will grab a [specific version](https://github.com/posit-dev/positron/blob/b6f7586887277c30eb520dbf445e658682c2b8ca/extensions/positron-python/package.json#L1978) of the PET to be used in the `positron-python` extension.

Following Kallichore's lead, we'll need builds for:
- [X]  macos arm64 and x64 (as a universal build)
- [X] windows x64
- [X] linux x64
- [x] linux arm 64
